text: Every personal detail in this message is about to disappear, before a single word of it reaches the cloud.
Clinic front desks, support agents and HR teams paste messages like this into cloud AI every day.
Names, ID numbers, phone numbers, home addresses. All of it sent to a server they don't control.
Airlock is built on Firebase AI Logic hybrid inference. Here in Chrome, Gemini Nano is ready on this device, and Gemini in the cloud is set up for the writing.
Press redact. Gemini Nano and local pattern rules look for every personal detail.
Each one is struck out and swapped for a placeholder, right here on the device.
The middle panel is exactly what the cloud will see.
Every hidden detail shows who found it, Gemini Nano or a pattern rule, and you can show or hide anything before you send.
Now send. Only the redacted text goes to Gemini in the cloud, through Firebase AI Logic.
The reply comes back with placeholders, and Airlock restores the real details locally, highlighted so you can check them.
Flip this toggle to see what the cloud model actually wrote. Placeholders, nothing else.
The egress log records every request that left the device, with its full payload.
Airlock. The small model on your device guards the private details. The big model in the cloud does the writing.
Open source, and built on Firebase AI Logic.
